title: SWF: folder layers not skipped in compile.ts depth/frame loops
description: All layer iteration loops in compile.ts skip layer.type === 'guide' but have no equivalent check for layer.type === 'folder'. Folder layers are authoring-only organizational containers that must emit no SWF content. Currently safe because flash8-import.ts produces folder layers with only a blank createFrame(0) with no displayObjects, but a programmatically-created folder layer with content would be incorrectly included in the SWF and assigned a depth slot. Fix: add 'if (layer.type === "folder") continue' alongside the existing guide checks at lines 937, 1066, 1137, 1326, and 1558.
